description: When a traffic management program or restriction (TFMS flow information: a ground stop, ground delay program, airspace flow program or a facility's restriction) stops being kept: its own end where the Command Center gives one, else six hours after it was heard, a design bound (the ATCSCC advises each program's effective period and its revisions, FAA JO 7210.3 chapter 17).

heard.description: When it was heard, Unix seconds.

ends.description: Its own end, Unix seconds, where the advisory or restriction gives one.
When it is no longer kept, Unix seconds.
